caseName: Sage Stores Co. v. Kansas ex rel. Mitchell
caseNameFull: Sage Stores Co. v. Kansas ex rel. Mitchell, Attorney General
attorneys: Messrs. Samuel H. Kaufman, George Trosk, Milton Adler, and Thomas M. Lillard for petitioners. Messrs. A. B. Mitchell, Attorney General of Kansas, and C. Glenn Morris for respondent.
